value.actual_behavior:
Read at 2026-09-06T18:10Z, all 20 rows on GET /api/v1/bounty/reports carry
reward_status pending_award and reward_amount 0.0 -- so the half of #68 about
an amount sitting outside its band is genuinely resolved, and our check no
longer asserts it. The currency half is untouched: 19 rows name ET10 and one
names USDC, every one of them beside an eligible_reward_range published in
CYM.
value.description:
Crediting the part that moved: zeroing the amounts and marking the rows
pending_award is an honest answer to the amount half, and it retired that half
of the check rather than papering over it. Our own check had to be repaired to
see it -- it was reading any numeric reward_amount as a recorded award and so
kept reporting "0 recorded against 25000-100000" about reports that had been
awarded nothing. That was our error and it is fixed on our side.
What still reads as two statements about one row that cannot both be true: the
award currency. Nothing has been paid, so this is not a payment dispute -- it
is that a row promises an entitlement in CYM and names a different currency
for the award beside it.
Two details that may point at the cause. First, #68 is the only row of the
twenty that reads USDC; the other nineteen still read ET10. Since #68 is the
report that raised this, it looks like the row that was named got edited
rather than the mechanism that fills the field -- and it moved to a third
currency, so #68 now disagrees with both its own band and its nineteen
siblings. Second, #68 carries severity_confirmed=null while the band beside it
is keyed to severity=medium, which is its severity_reported. If the
entitlement is derived from the reporter's own severity claim rather than a
confirmed one, that is worth knowing independently of the currency.
#68 was moved to fixed at 2026-09-06T17:39:26 with status_notes null and
fix_pr_url null, so there is nothing on the record saying what changed. If the
intended resolution is that awards are paid in ET10 or USDC and the CYM ranges
are legacy copy, saying so on the report closes this without any code change
-- the check only asserts that the two agree, not which of them is right.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-award-contradicts-its-own-tier] 20 row(s) name one currency for the award and publish the entitlement beside it in another (e.g. #68: to be paid in USDC, entitled in CYM)
    left: [68, 67, 66, 65, 64, 63, 61, 60]
    right: 0
    sources: {'tracker': '/api/v1/bounty/reports', 'tiers': '/api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers'}
    population: {'rows': 20, 'awarded': 0, 'measured': 0, 'without_a_band': 0, 'currency_mismatch': 20, 'below_published_minimum': 0}

REPRODUCE:
  - GET /api/v1/bounty/reports (no auth)
  - Every row: reward_status=pending_award, reward_amount=0.0
  - 19 rows: reward_currency=ET10 beside eligible_reward_range.currency=CYM
  - Report #68: reward_currency=USDC beside eligible_reward_range {min 25000, max 100000, currency CYM, severity medium}
  - Report #68: severity_confirmed=null, while the band it publishes is keyed to severity=medium, which is its severity_reported

AUTOMATED CHECKS (public repo: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica):
  tests/rest/test_award_matches_its_tier.py::test_a_recorded_award_agrees_with_the_tier_on_the_same_row

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
A row publishing eligible_reward_range in one currency should name that same
currency for its award, so the two statements on one row can both be true.
value.steps_to_reproduce:
GET /api/v1/bounty/reports (no auth)
Every row: reward_status=pending_award, reward_amount=0.0
19 rows: reward_currency=ET10 beside eligible_reward_range.currency=CYM
Report #68: reward_currency=USDC beside eligible_reward_range {min 25000, max 100000, currency CYM, severity medium}
Report #68: severity_confirmed=null, while the band it publishes is keyed to severity=medium, which is its severity_reported
